description: This file defines the 'FilterExpression' class in the Twig template engine, which represents a filter applied to a node in the Twig parse tree. It manages filter attributes, deprecation warnings, and compilation logic for rendering templates.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\FilterExpression
classes.description: Represents a filter applied to an expression node, extending CallExpression, with methods for construction and compilation, including handling of deprecations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a FilterExpression with the given node, filter, arguments, and line number, setting attributes and deprecation warnings.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the filter expression into PHP code using the provided Compiler instance, handling special filter names and setting callable attributes.
